name: Bloodmaster's Ring
summary: A ring announcer calls for you to face Mog’thar in the Bloodmaster’s Ring. The crowd is waiting for its next contender.

sections.title: The Next Contender
sections.body: The announcer has kept the crowd excited and now presents Mog’thar as the next contender. You are called into the Bloodmaster’s Ring, with the crowd waiting to see what happens.

faq.q: Who do I face in the Bloodmaster’s Ring?
faq.answer: You are called to face Mog’thar in the Bloodmaster’s Ring.

faq.q: What does the announcer say about Mog’thar?
faq.answer: The announcer says Mog’thar is no joke.

faq.q: Why am I being sent into the ring?
faq.answer: The announcer wants to keep the crowd’s excitement going by presenting another contender.
